title: GO; I WILL HELP YOU SPEAK

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: ""Now go; I will help you speak and will teach you what to say."" - Exodus 4:12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Two short commands and two magnificent promises. Go — I will help you speak — I will teach you what to say.

God does not send anyone empty. He never says go and then leaves us to manage on our own. Every command of God carries His enabling with it.

Notice the order. The going comes first. God does not say, "Once you feel eloquent, then go." He says go, and I will help you as you go. The help arrives in the doing, not before it.

Many of us are waiting to feel ready. We will be waiting a long time. Readiness is not a feeling we work up; it is a promise we lean on.

Jesus gave His disciples the same assurance when they would be dragged before authorities — do not worry about what to say, for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time (Lk 12:12). The same God who taught Moses teaches His people still.

Speak for Him today, even shakily. He will meet you in the sentence.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What conversation have I been avoiding because I do not know what to say?
2. Am I waiting to feel ready instead of trusting God's promise to help?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I will go even though I feel unready. Teach me what to say and help me to say it. Amen.
